title: Windsurf v1.9600.41 - Adaptive Model Router Bug Fix
description: Fixed critical bug with the adaptive model router which prevented switching models after the first request. All affected users had quota reset and overage restored.

title: Devin April 2026 Updates - Enterprise Features and Auto-Fix
description: Multiple updates throughout April including Enterprise-scoped secrets management, Devin Review Auto-Fix button for one-click bug fixes, PR Resuming for taking over existing PRs across sessions, Streaming Terminals for real-time output, and Light Mode (Beta).

title: Windsurf v1.9600.40 - Adaptive Model Visibility Improvements
description: Improved visibility of the adaptive model in the model picker, helping users better understand which model is being selected for their tasks.

title: Windsurf v1.9600.38 - Introducing Adaptive Model Router
description: Launched new Adaptive model option that intelligently selects the best model for each task, helping users make their quota last longer by avoiding overuse of premium models. Updated model picker now shows token pricing information directly. Extra usage promo: $0.50/M input tokens, $2.00/M output tokens for 2 weeks.

community_feedback.quote: We've heard clear feedback that our new pricing plans were too opaque and, in some cases, restrictive
teams hitting overages they didn't budget for

title: Cursor 3.0 - New Interface, Agents Window, and Bugbot Learned Rules
description: Major release featuring Cursor 3 with new Agents Window for running multiple agents in parallel across repos and environments, Design Mode for UI element annotation, Bugbot with learned rules from PR feedback, MCP support for Bugbot, self-hosted cloud agents, Composer 2 with frontier-level coding performance, and 30+ new plugins from partners.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor 3 discussion on Hacker News mirror

title: Claude Code v2.1.98 - Enhanced Security, MCP, and Vertex AI Integration
description: Major update featuring interactive Google Vertex AI setup wizard, Monitor tool for background script events, subprocess sandboxing with PID namespace isolation, and multiple critical security fixes including Bash tool permission bypass prevention. Also includes W3C TRACEPARENT support for OpenTelemetry tracing.

title: Continue v1.3.38, v1.3.37, v1.3.36, v1.3.35 (VS Code & JetBrains)
description: Multiple releases in late March 2026 featuring config.yaml fixes, session history filtering by workspace directory, .continue/configs support, Ollama tool support improvements, critical and high security vulnerability fixes, JetBrains stability improvements including preventing IDE freezes and sidebar freezes, and ClawRouter provider for cost-optimized model routing.

title: Aider v0.56.0 - Prompt Caching and Enhanced Output
description: Enabled prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter and 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5. Added new /report command to open browser with pre-populated GitHub Issue, new --chat-language switch for spoken language, and --suggest-shell-commands controls for shell command prompting. Aider wrote 56% of the code in this release.
